biotools.summary: ChIP-GPT is a large language model fine-tuned to extract metadata from biomedical databases, particularly focusing on chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) targets and cell lines. It demonstrates high accuracy in extracting data even from records with errors and is adaptable to different databases.
